title: KestrelCare Mileage Wear Table for Remainder Authorizations
content:
On a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts remainder authorization, a wear deduction applies to the amount payable after the deductible, read from the odometer on the repair order as recorded on the Kestrel limited warranty decision of the vehicle's Vehicle Purchase Agreements purchase order:

- at or above 100000 miles the amount is reduced by the high-mileage wear rate of 15 percent;
- at or above 75000 miles but below 100000 miles it is reduced by the mid-mileage wear rate of 10 percent;
- below 75000 miles there is no wear deduction.

The reduced amount is the amount multiplied by one less the wear rate; the reduction is made before the comparison with the per-visit limit and the coverage remaining.

| Odometer on the repair order | Wear rate | Amount kept |
|---|---|---|
| 74999 or less | none | 100 percent |
| 75000 | 10 percent | 90 percent |
| 99999 | 10 percent | 90 percent |
| 100000 | 15 percent | 85 percent |
| above 100000 | 15 percent | 85 percent |

*Hypothetical figure:* an amount of 2000.00 after the deductible on a repair order at 101500 miles becomes 1700.00; at 82000 miles it becomes 1800.00; at 61000 miles it stays 2000.00.
